definitions: To get a share or portion of something.
To participate in something profitable or desirable.
examples: Everyone wants to get a piece of the pie when a new company goes public.
She worked hard to get a piece of the pie in the booming tech industry.
After years of effort, he finally got a piece of the pie.
lemma: to get a piece of the pie
synonyms: to get a slice of the action
source: to get a piece of the pie
